questions.question: What does the term ‘interest’ refer to in banking?

options.text: The additional amount earned on a loan or deposit
The amount of money deposited into a bank account
The value of a currency in relation to other currencies
The fee charged for withdrawing money from an ATM

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The additional amount earned on a loan or deposit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Interest** in banking refers to the **additional amount earned on a loan or deposit**.
 
• When you deposit money in a bank account, the bank pays you interest as a return on your deposit.
 
• Conversely, when you take a loan from a bank, you pay interest as a cost for borrowing the money.
 
• Interest rates can vary based on the type of account or loan and the current economic conditions.
 
• Understanding interest is crucial for managing personal finances effectively, whether saving or borrowing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are two types of interest: **simple interest** and **compound interest**.
 
• **Simple interest** is calculated on the principal amount of a loan or deposit.
 
• **Compound interest** is calculated on the principal amount and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods.
 
• Interest rates are influenced by the central bank's policies, inflation, and other economic factors.
 
• In India, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** regulates interest rates to control the money supply and maintain economic stability.

questions.question: Bihu is a folk dance of which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihu** is a traditional folk dance of the state of **Assam**.
 
• Bihu is celebrated during the **Bihu festival**, which is a set of three different festivals: **Bohag Bihu** or Rongali Bihu, **Kati Bihu** or Kongali Bihu, and **Magh Bihu** or Bhogali Bihu, marking the **Assamese New Year **and the **change of seasons**.
 
• The dance is characterized by brisk dance steps, quick hand movements, and rhythmic beats played on the traditional Assamese musical instruments like the dhol, pepa (horn), and taal (cymbals).
 
• Bihu dance is performed by both young men and women, and it reflects the joy and celebration of the Assamese people.
 
• The dance is a key aspect of Assamese culture and heritage, symbolizing the rich tradition and the vibrant spirit of the community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam** is located in the northeastern part of India and is known for its rich cultural heritage and natural beauty.
 
• The state is also famous for its **Assam tea**, **silk**, and the **Kaziranga National Park**, which is home to the **one-horned rhinoceros**.
 
• Assam is a land of diverse communities, ethnic groups, and languages, contributing to its unique cultural mosaic.
 
• The Bihu festival is an integral part of Assamese culture, celebrated with great enthusiasm and fervor by people of all ages.
 
• In addition to the Bihu dance, other traditional dances of Assam include the **Sattriya** dance, which is a classical dance form recognized by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.

questions.question: In which year did Lord Curzon announce the partition of Bengal during the British rule in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1905**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Curzon** announced the partition of Bengal in the year **1905**.
 
• The partition was carried out on **16th October 1905**, and it divided the province of Bengal into two parts: **Eastern Bengal and Assam** and **West Bengal**.
 
• The partition was intended to improve administrative efficiency in the large and populous region but was widely seen as an **attempt to divide **and rule by creating religious divisions between **Hindus and Muslims**.
 
• This move led to widespread protests and was a significant event in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The partition was eventually annulled in **1911** due to the strong opposition and unrest it generated among the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Curzon** served as the Viceroy of India from **1899 to 1905**.
 
• The partition of Bengal was a significant event that contributed to the rise of **nationalist movements** in India.
 
• The Swadeshi Movement, which promoted indigenous industries and the boycott of British goods, gained momentum in response to the partition.
 
• The **annulment of the partition in 1911 **was announced during the visit of **King George V **to India.
 
• The **capital **of British India was also **shifted from Calcutta **(now Kolkata) to **Delhi **in **1911**.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Power Sector’s Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme?

1) The Prime Minister launched the Ministry of Power’s flagship Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme in 2022.

2) This scheme is aimed at improving the operational efficiencies and financial sustainability of distribution companies.

3) From FY 2022-23 to FY 2027-28, the scheme aims to provide financial assistance to DISCOMs.

4)This scheme proposes to provide 25 crore Smart Prepaid meters to consumers all over the country.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Prime Minister launched the** Ministry of Power’s flagship Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme in 2022**. Therefore, statement 1 is correct.
 
• The Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) aims to **assist DISCOMs in enhancing their operational efficiencies and financial sustainability** by providing result-linked financial assistance. Therefore, statement 2 is correct.
 
 
• This support is contingent on meeting pre-qualifying criteria and achieving basic minimum benchmarks.
 
 
 
• The scheme has a total outlay of Rs 3,03,758 crore over five years, from **FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26**, which includes an estimated Government Budgetary Support (GBS) of Rs 97,631 crore. Therefore, statement 3 is not correct.
 
 
• It aims to reduce AT&C losses to 12-15% across India by 2024-25 and eliminate the ACS-ARR gap by the same year.
 
 
 
• It is also proposed to provide** 25 crore Smart Prepaid meters** to consumers all over the country. Therefore, statement 4 is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme also seeks to improve the quality, reliability, and affordability of power supply to consumers through a financially sustainable and operationally efficient distribution sector.
 
• **Key components of the scheme include-**
 
 
• Part A, which provides financial support for Prepaid Smart Metering, System Metering, and the upgradation of Distribution Infrastructure.
 
• Part B focuses on Training & Capacity Building and other Enabling & Supporting Activities.
 
 
 
• The **REC and Power Finance Corporation (PFC) **have been appointed as the nodal agencies to facilitate the implementation of the scheme.
 
• The RDSS is designed to modernize the power distribution infrastructure and enhance the performance of DISCOMs.
 
• It ensures better service to consumers and achieves significant operational and financial improvements in the power sector.

questions.question: ‘Mein Kampf’ is the autobiography of which world personality?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Adolf Hitler**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adolf Hitler** authored the autobiography **'Mein Kampf'**.
 
• The book outlines Hitler's **political ideology and future plans for Germany**.
 
• It was written during his imprisonment in **1923 **following his failed coup attempt in Munich.
 
• 'Mein Kampf' translates to **'My Struggle'** in English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The book is divided into two volumes, with the first volume published in 1925 and the second in 1926.
 
• It is considered a cornerstone of **Nazi ideology **and provides insight into Hitler's mindset and the propaganda used by the Nazi party.
 
• Despite its controversial nature, 'Mein Kampf' remains a significant historical document for understanding the causes and consequences of World War II.
 
• Post-World War II, the book was banned in several countries due to its promotion of hate and anti-Semitism.

questions.question: What is the geographic location of the world's largest coral reef, known as the Great Barrier Reef?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Great Barrier Reef** is the world's largest coral reef system, located in the Coral Sea, off the coast of **Queensland, Australia**.
 
• The reef is composed of over **2,900 individual reefs **and **900 islands **stretching for over **2,300 kilometers **(1,400 miles).
 
• It is the only living structure visible from space and is renowned for its vibrant marine life, including a variety of fish, corals, and other marine creatures.
 
• The Great Barrier Reef is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site **and is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the world, attracting millions of visitors each year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Great Barrier Reef is home to a wide variety of marine species, including over 1,500 species of fish, 400 species of coral, and several species of sharks and rays.
 
• It plays a crucial role in supporting marine biodiversity and is an important natural asset for scientific research and environmental conservation.
 
• The reef is facing significant threats from **climate change, coral bleaching, pollution, and overfishing**, which have led to efforts for its preservation and protection.
 
• Conservation initiatives include **marine protected areas, sustainable tourism practices**, and research programs aimed at understanding and mitigating the impacts of human activities on the reef.

questions.question: Popular since ancient eras for the trading of livestock, ___________, which is a monthlong event, takes place on the auspicious occasion of Kartik Purnima in the month of November near Harihar Nath temple.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonepur Mela**__

__
 
• **Sonepur Mela** is a monthlong event that takes place on the auspicious occasion of **Kartik Purnima **in the month of **November **near **Harihar Nath temple**.
 
• It is popular since ancient eras for the trading of livestock.
 
• The fair attracts visitors from all over India and even from foreign countries.
 
• It is one of the largest cattle fairs in Asia, where various animals including elephants, horses, cows, and birds are traded.
 
• The Sonepur Mela also features a variety of cultural events and activities, including folk dances, songs, and magic shows, making it a significant cultural event in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The fair is held at the confluence of the **Ganges and Gandak rivers**, adding to its spiritual significance.
 
• It is also known as the **Harihar Kshetra Mela**, named after the nearby Harihar Nath temple.
 
• The fair has a historical legacy dating back to the Mauryan Empire, making it not only a commercial event but also a part of India's rich cultural heritage.
 
• Over the years, the fair has evolved to include modern attractions such as amusement rides, circus shows, and a variety of stalls selling handicrafts, garments, and traditional foods.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the six communication mail channels in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Monthly channel**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The six communication mail channels in India are crucial for the efficient delivery of mail across the country.
 
• These channels include the **Metro channel, Rajdhani channel, Business channel, Bulk mail channel, Periodical channel,** and the **Express channel**.
 
• The **Monthly channel** is not a recognized communication mail channel in India.
 
• Each of these channels is designed to cater to specific types of mail and delivery requirements, ensuring timely and organized mail distribution.
 
• The **Metro channel** focuses on mail within metropolitan areas, while the **Rajdhani channel** is for express mail between major cities.
 
• The **Business channel** and **Bulk mail channel** handle large volumes of business and bulk mail, respectively.
 
• The **Periodical channel** is dedicated to the distribution of periodicals and magazines, and the **Express channel** is used for urgent deliveries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian postal system **is one of the most extensive networks in the world, playing a vital role in communication and logistics.
 
• Established in **1854**, the Indian postal service has evolved significantly, adapting to modern communication needs while maintaining traditional services.
 
• The postal system also supports various financial services, including savings accounts, insurance, and money transfer services.
 
• With the advent of digital communication, the Indian postal service has integrated technology to enhance efficiency and service delivery.
 
• Initiatives such as e-post, track and trace, and online postal services have modernized the traditional postal system, making it more accessible and user-friendly.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a non-debt capital receipt in the government budget?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sale of government-owned land**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sale of government-owned land** is considered a **non-debt capital receipt **in the government budget.
 
• Non-debt capital receipts are funds received by the government that do not create any future liabilities.
 
• These receipts include disinvestment proceeds, recovery of loans, and sale of government assets.
 
• Unlike debt receipts, non-debt capital receipts do not have to be repaid, thus they do not burden the future budgets with repayment obligations.
 
• Such receipts are crucial for funding various government expenditures without increasing the debt burden.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Loans from international financial institutions** and **interest payment on government bonds** are examples of **debt receipts **and expenditures, respectively.
 
• **Tax revenue collected from citizens** is a form of **revenue receipt**, not a capital receipt.
 
• Non-debt capital receipts help in **managing the fiscal deficit** and are a part of the government's strategy to maintain financial stability.
 
• Effective utilization of non-debt capital receipts can reduce the need for borrowing and help in better fiscal management.

Swelling and bleeding of the gums

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Yellowing of the skin and the whites of the eyes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yellowing of the skin and the whites of the eyes** is the most obvious symptom of infantile jaundice.
 
• This symptom typically appears between the **second and fourth day after birth**.
 
• Infantile jaundice is caused by a high level of bilirubin, a yellow substance that the body creates when it replaces old red blood cells.
 
• Most cases of jaundice in infants are mild and resolve on their own, but some cases may require medical intervention.
 
• Early detection and monitoring are crucial to prevent potential complications such as kernicterus, a type of brain damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaundice in newborns** is a common condition, affecting approximately 60% of full-term and 80% of preterm infants.
 
• It is typically seen as a yellowish tint to the skin and eyes and is more noticeable when pressing a finger on the baby's skin.
 
• Parents are advised to seek medical attention if the jaundice appears severe, spreads, or the baby shows signs of poor feeding, lethargy, or high-pitched crying.
 
• Treatment options may include phototherapy or, in more severe cases, exchange transfusion.
 
• Regular follow-up with a healthcare provider ensures the jaundice is resolving and the baby is healthy.

questions.question: The Units of Linear momentum are measured in _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**kg m/s**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **kg m/s** is the unit of linear momentum in the International System of Units (SI).
 
• Linear momentum is defined as the product of an object's mass and its velocity.
 
• The formula for linear momentum (p) is given by: p = m * v, where m is mass in kilograms (kg) and is velocity in meters per second (m/s).
 
• This unit signifies the quantity of motion an object possesses, which is a vector quantity having both magnitude and direction.
 
• It plays a crucial role in various principles of physics, including the conservation of momentum in closed systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Linear momentum** is a fundamental concept in classical mechanics and is conserved in isolated systems, according to the law of conservation of momentum.
 
• In collisions and interactions, the total linear momentum before the event is equal to the total linear momentum after the event, provided no external forces act on the system.
 
• Linear momentum is also related to force through Newton's second law, which states that the rate of change of momentum of an object is equal to the net force acting on it.
 
• Understanding momentum is essential for analyzing various physical phenomena, including motion, collisions, and the behavior of objects under different forces.

questions.question: Punjab state is rich in which natural resource from the following?
questions.solution:

• **Fertile soil** is one of the major natural resources of Punjab.
 
• Punjab is known for its rich and fertile alluvial soil, which is highly conducive for agriculture.
 
• This fertile soil has made Punjab one of the leading agricultural states in India, producing significant quantities of wheat, rice, and other crops.
 
• The state's agricultural productivity is a key contributor to India's food grain production.

• The state benefits from an extensive irrigation system, primarily sourced from the rivers Sutlej, Beas, and Ravi.
 
• Punjab's agriculture sector plays a crucial role in ensuring food security for the nation.
 
• In addition to fertile soil, Punjab also has a well-developed infrastructure for the distribution and marketing of agricultural produce.
 
• The Green Revolution in India significantly boosted Punjab's agricultural productivity in the 1960s and 1970s.
 
• Punjab's farmers are known for their progressive farming techniques and adoption of modern agricultural practices.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in our Constitution as of June 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of June 2024, there are **12 schedules** in the Constitution of India.
 
• Schedules in the Constitution provide details on various aspects that are elaborated in the articles of the Constitution.
 
• The schedules cover subjects such as the allocation of powers and functions between the Union and States, administration and control of scheduled areas and tribes, and other administrative details.
 
• The schedules are an essential part of the Constitution, providing clarity and detailed information on various governance aspects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule **of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The schedules have been amended several times to meet the evolving needs of the nation.
